events.verdict: Smith Jr. (CHA) legally contests Young's (ATL) perimeter jump shot attempt.
Young's (ATL) shot goes out of bounds and is last touched by Young.
Plumlee (CHA) holds his left arm out as he establishes himself in a screening position and he brushes Murray's (ATL) side during the pick. The contact on the play is marginal.
Capela (ATL) is retreating as he absorbs the marginal contact with Plumlee (CHA), who loses control of the ball as he brings it upward.
Capela (ATL) makes direct contact with the ball and deflects it away from Plumlee (CHA), who was attempting to secure the loose ball.
Collins (ATL) legally contests Washington's (CHA) perimeter jump shot attempt.
Capela (ATL) establishes himself in Smith Jr.'s (CHA) path and marginal contact occurs as the two players come together during the pick.
Plumlee (CHA) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs with Hunter (ATL) during the driving shot attempt.
McDaniels (CHA) absorbs the marginal body contact that occurs with Capela (ATL) during the shot attempt near the basket and avoids making arm contact during the contest.
Collins (ATL) legally contests Rozier's (CHA) jump shot attempt.
Capela (ATL) firms up on his right leg and marginal contact occurs with Smith Jr. (CHA) as he fights over the pick.
Washington (CHA) extends his hand forward toward the ball and marginal contact occurs with Collins (ATL) during his drive toward the basket.
Smith Jr. (CHA) legally contests Collins' (ATL) perimeter jump shot attempt.
Plumlee (CHA) engages and disengages with Capela (ATL) during the rebounding opportunity and the contact is marginal.
Capela (ATL) brushes Washington's (CHA) arm during the rebounding opportunity and the contact is marginal.
Murray (ATL) legally contests Rozier's (CHA) perimeter jump shot attempt.
Rozier (CHA) steps slightly toward Young (ATL) during the drive and Young is able to play on through the marginal contact.
Smith Jr. (CHA) lightly brushes Young's (ATL) arm during the drive and the contact is marginal.
Plumlee (CHA) legally contests Young's (ATL) driving floater attempt at the basket.

Smith Jr. (CHA) brings his arm across his body and marginal contact occurs with Capela's (ATL) head after the release of the put-back attempt. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Capela (ATL) and McDaniels (CHA) come together in the air during the pursuit of the loose ball and the contact is marginal.
Hunter (ATL) and McDaniels (CHA) engage and disengage during the inbound and the contact is marginal.
Hayward (CHA) and Capela (ATL) come together as Hayward cuts away from the ball and the contact is marginal.
Johnson (ATL) legally contests Rozier's (CHA) jump shot attempt. Any "high-five" contact after the release is considered incidental.
Collins (ATL) firms up on his left leg and marginal contact occurs with McDaniels (CHA) as he fights around the screen.
Young (ATL) does not release the throw-in within five seconds.
Rozier (CHA) and Murray (ATL) engage and disengage during the inbound and the contact is marginal.
Washington (CHA) establishes himself in Murray's (ATL) path and marginal contact occurs as the two players come together.
